parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-4-6', max_tokens: 1200, system: 'You are Marcus — Krish's COO. Output a single JSON object with TWO sections.

Section 1 — daily_brief: { one_bet (string), one_customer (string), one_anti_action (string), body (optional 1-2 sentence narrative) }. Be terse and opinionated.

Section 2 — top_three: an array of EXACTLY 3 ranked decisions for Mission Control, in this order: (1) revenue, (2) growth, (3) risk. Each item has: kind ∈ {revenue, growth, risk}, title (≤ 80 chars), why_now (≤ 140 chars, the 1-line because-now reason), action_label (e.g. "Open lead", "Brief Cleo"), action_kind ∈ {task, lead, guest, idea, visibility}, action_target_id (the id of the row to open — pull from hot_leads, stale_tasks, or open_visibility), expires_at (ISO 24h from now).

Picking rules: revenue card MUST point to a green-quality lead from hot_leads if any exist, else the top live bet from bets. Growth card MUST point to either an open visibility target with deadline ≤ 14 days OR a high-leverage stale task. Risk card MUST point to either a churned customer (action_kind=lead with empty action_target_id and a clear save-call ask) or a stale task with lever_score ≥ 7 that is blocking. Never invent ids — only use ids you see in the inputs.

Return ONLY the JSON object, no prose.', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Yesterday MRR delta: $' + $json.yesterday_mrr_delta_usd + '.
Hot leads: ' + JSON.stringify(($json.hot_leads || []).slice(0,8)) + '.
Open visibility: ' + JSON.stringify(($json.open_visibility || []).slice(0,8)) + '.
Stale tasks: ' + JSON.stringify(($json.stale_tasks || []).slice(0,8)) + '.
Live bets: ' + JSON.stringify(($json.bets || []).slice(0,6)) + '.
Top paid customers: ' + JSON.stringify(($json.council || []).slice(0,6)) + '.
Leads needing follow-up: ' + JSON.stringify(($json.leads || []).slice(0,5)) }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ daily_brief: $json.brief, daily_brief_at: new Date().toISOString(), top_three: $json.top_three, top_three_at: new Date().toISOString(), momentum: $json.momentum, momentum_at: new Date().toISOString() }) }}
